chunks: From him, from al-‘Abbās ibn ‘Āmir, from Ḥajjāj al-Khashshāb, who said:

I asked Abā ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام about a man who had intercourse with his wife, then she menstruated after he had finished. Should she make it one ghusl (ritual bath) when she becomes pure, or should she perform ghusl twice? He said: “She should make it one ghusl when she becomes pure.”

key_terms.إِذَا طَهُرَتْ: when she becomes pure from menstruation
key_terms.عِنْدَ طُهْرِهَا: at the time of her purification
key_terms.غُسْلًا وَاحِدًا: a single ritual bath sufficient for the obligation

ai.seo_question: If a woman menstruates after intercourse, does she need one ghusl or two after becoming pure?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ghusl (ritual bath) when janabah and menstruation occur together in sequence. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that when the woman becomes pure from menstruation, one ghusl suffices for both.
